lines.zh: 蹄子踏过平原，扬起一线灰。
lines.en: My hooves cross the plains, kicking up a grey line of dust.

lines.zh: 我走在牛群最外侧，替它们挡风。
lines.en: I walk on the herd's outer edge and take the wind for them.

lines.zh: 灰白的背脊在草浪里忽隐忽现。
lines.en: My pale back rises and falls through the waves of grass.

lines.zh: 往河边去，尘土把皮染得更白。
lines.en: Down to the river, where dust bleaches my coat whiter.

lines.zh: 尾巴一甩，赶走跟着我的蝇。
lines.en: One flick of my tail scatters the flies trailing me.

lines.zh: 草叶扫过肚子，痒得我加快脚步。
lines.en: Grass tickles my belly, so I quicken my pace.

lines.zh: 那头棕牛走偏了，我跟过去。
lines.en: The brown one has strayed; I drift over to follow it.

lines.zh: 沿着篱笆慢慢挪，省些力气。
lines.en: I creep along the fence, saving what strength I have.

lines.zh: 影子很短，正午的平原很烫。
lines.en: My shadow is short; the noon plains are hot underfoot.

lines.zh: 四蹄踩进泥里，拔出来带着响声。
lines.en: My hooves sink in mud and come out with a wet pop.

lines.zh: 别挤，我这条腿还没站稳。
lines.en: Don't push; this leg of mine isn't steady yet.

lines.zh: 草尖上的露水打湿了我的膝盖。
lines.en: Dew on the grass tips soaks my knees as I go.

lines.zh: 牛铃响一下，我的步子就齐一下。
lines.en: Each clink of the bell straightens my stride.

lines.zh: 灰白的影子拖得很长，天要黑了。
lines.en: My pale shadow stretches long; dusk is coming.

lines.zh: 我跟着前面那头牛的尾巴。
lines.en: I follow the tail of the cow ahead.

lines.zh: 下坡时我把蹄子踩稳。
lines.en: I plant my hooves on the slope down.

lines.zh: 我嚼着草，慢慢想些没用的事。
lines.en: I chew and think about nothing in particular.

lines.zh: 反刍的时候，世界安静得发闷。
lines.en: While I chew my cud, the world goes muffled and still.

lines.zh: 灰白的皮在阳光下有点发热。
lines.en: This pale hide of mine grows warm in the sun.

lines.zh: 远处的牛叫了一声，我抬抬头。
lines.en: A cow lows far off; I raise my head a little.

lines.zh: 风吹过背上的灰，像有人拂了一下。
lines.en: Wind brushes the ash off my back like a hand.

lines.zh: 站着也能睡，我练过很多回。
lines.en: I can sleep standing up; I've practiced plenty.

lines.zh: 耳朵转到左边，那里有动静。
lines.en: One ear turns left; something moved over there.

lines.zh: 我的角不长，但还算对称。
lines.en: My horns aren't long, but at least they match.

lines.zh: 牛群都趴下了，我也该趴下。
lines.en: The herd has lain down, so I may as well.

lines.zh: 晒够一面，我转过去晒另一面。
lines.en: One side warmed, I turn to catch the sun on the other.

lines.zh: 我在数云，数到第三朵就忘了。
lines.en: I'm counting clouds; I lose it at the third.

lines.zh: 那片草被踩平了，明天还会长。
lines.en: That patch is trampled flat; it'll grow back by morning.

lines.zh: 呼吸慢下来，肚子一起一伏。
lines.en: My breathing slows; my flank rises and falls.

lines.zh: 没人来赶我，我可以站到天黑。
lines.en: No one shoos me; I can stand here till dark.

lines.zh: 我甩尾巴的次数越来越少。
lines.en: I flick my tail less and less.

lines.zh: 泥地上的影子慢慢移过去。
lines.en: My shadow creeps across the mud.

lines.zh: 你身上有小麦的味道吗？
lines.en: Do you smell of wheat, by any chance?

lines.zh: 我抬眼看看你，又低头吃草。
lines.en: I glance up at you, then go back to the grass.

lines.zh: 你站得太近了，我退半步。
lines.en: You're standing too close; I take half a step back.

lines.zh: 你手里那把东西，是给我的吗？
lines.en: That bundle by your hand, is it mine?

lines.zh: 灰白的眼睛盯着你，不带恶意。
lines.en: My pale eyes rest on you without a trace of malice.

lines.zh: 你走路的样子，不像狼。
lines.en: The way you walk doesn't look like a wolf.

lines.zh: 我认得你的靴子，昨天也来过。
lines.en: I know those boots; they came by yesterday too.

lines.zh: 别摸角，那里最怕痒。
lines.en: Not the horns; that's the ticklish spot.

lines.zh: 你要是坐下，我也许会靠近。
lines.en: If you sit down, I might come closer.

lines.zh: 我的头歪着，是在听你说话。
lines.en: My head is tilted because I'm listening to you.

lines.zh: 你挡住了风，我倒不介意。
lines.en: You're blocking the wind; I don't mind at all.

lines.zh: 看够了就走吧，草还等着我。
lines.en: Once you've looked enough, go on; the grass is waiting.

lines.zh: 我的皮被划开了，疼。
lines.en: My hide is split open; that hurts.

lines.zh: 别打了，我只是一头牛。
lines.en: Stop hitting me; I'm only a cow.

lines.zh: 我退了好几步，草都被踩烂。
lines.en: I stagger back and crush the grass.

lines.zh: 这伤要好久才能长好。
lines.en: A wound like this takes a long time to close.

lines.zh: 我低声叫，声音都变了。
lines.en: I low, and my voice has changed.

lines.zh: 血滴在灰白的毛上，很显眼。
lines.en: Blood on this pale coat shows clearly.

lines.zh: 我站不稳，往一边倒。
lines.en: I can't hold steady and lean to one side.

lines.zh: 牛群散开了，没人护着我。
lines.en: The herd scatters; no one shields me.

lines.zh: 我喘得很急，肋骨在响。
lines.en: My breathing is ragged; my ribs creak.

lines.zh: 还要再打？我这条腿都软了。
lines.en: Another hit? My legs have gone weak.

lines.zh: 小麦一出现，我的腿就自己动了。
lines.en: The moment wheat appears, my legs move on their own.

lines.zh: 别晃，我会一直跟着那束草。
lines.en: Don't wave it; I'll follow that bunch forever.

lines.zh: 我闻到麦香，嘴里的草都不香了。
lines.en: I smell the wheat; the grass in my mouth turns bland.

lines.zh: 再给我一把，我就跟你走两步。
lines.en: One more handful and I'll walk two steps with you.

lines.zh: 你摊开手掌，我把鼻子凑过去。
lines.en: You open your palm and I press my nose to it.

lines.zh: 这可比平原上的草强多了。
lines.en: This beats anything growing out on the plains.

lines.zh: 我小跑起来，灰白的皮在抖。
lines.en: I break into a trot, my pale hide shaking.

lines.zh: 我蹭了蹭你的袖子，意思很明白。
lines.en: I nudge your sleeve; the meaning is clear.

lines.zh: 你要是把麦子举高，我就抬头。
lines.en: Lift the wheat higher and I'll raise my head.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子比眼睛先找到你。
lines.en: My nose finds you before my eyes do.

lines.zh: 一群牛都围过来，你最好多带点。
lines.en: The whole herd is closing in; bring more next time.

lines.zh: 我嘴里还嚼着，眼睛已盯着你手。
lines.en: Still chewing, my eyes are already on your hand.

lines.zh: 就一口，我不会咬到你的指头。
lines.en: Just one bite; I won't nip your fingers.

lines.zh: 我跟着麦香，能走到地图边上。
lines.en: I'd follow this wheat smell to the edge of the map.

lines.zh: 你一喊，我就知道有吃的。
lines.en: One call from you and I know there's food.

lines.zh: 我咬住那把麦子不肯松口。
lines.en: I clamp onto that wheat and won't let go.

lines.zh: 撞到了，我往旁边挪一挪。
lines.en: Sorry, I'll shuffle over a bit.

lines.zh: 你太矮了，我差点没看见。
lines.en: You're short; I nearly missed you.

lines.zh: 我的肩撞到你，皮厚不觉得疼。
lines.en: My shoulder caught you; this thick hide feels nothing.

lines.zh: 别推我，我这一身也不轻。
lines.en: Don't shove; there's a fair weight on these legs.

lines.zh: 我们挤在栅栏口，谁也过不去。
lines.en: We're jammed in the gate and nobody gets through.

lines.zh: 我让开一条道，你先走。
lines.en: I'll make a gap; you go first.

lines.zh: 蹄子踩到你的脚了吗？
lines.en: Did my hoof land on your foot?

lines.zh: 牛群里就是这样，肩膀碰肩膀。
lines.en: That's how a herd is: shoulder against shoulder.

lines.zh: 我侧过身子，灰毛蹭了你一身。
lines.en: I turn sideways and leave grey hair on your coat.

lines.zh: 撞一下不碍事，我皮糙肉厚。
lines.en: A bump is nothing; my hide is thick and rough.

lines.zh: 她舔我的额头，我站着不动。
lines.en: She licks my forehead and I stand very still.

lines.zh: 我们额头抵着额头，谁也没出声。
lines.en: We press foreheads and neither of us makes a sound.

lines.zh: 这头灰白的母牛，是我认下的。
lines.en: That pale cow is the one I've chosen.

lines.zh: 牛群里转一圈，我还是回到她身边。
lines.en: I circle the herd and still come back to her.

lines.zh: 我低声叫，怕惊着她。
lines.en: I low softly so as not to startle her.

lines.zh: 她的角比我的短一点，正好。
lines.en: Her horns are a little shorter than mine, just right.

lines.zh: 一起站着吃草，就是全部了。
lines.en: Standing and grazing together is the whole of it.

lines.zh: 我把下巴搁在她背上。
lines.en: I rest my chin on her back.

lines.zh: 别看了，我们只是并排站着。
lines.en: Nothing to see; we're only standing side by side.

lines.zh: 明年这时候，会多一头小牛。
lines.en: By this time next year there'll be a calf.

lines.zh: 我用嘴叼起那卷皮革。
lines.en: I pick up that roll of leather with my mouth.

lines.zh: 东西掉了，我帮你顶一下。
lines.en: You dropped something; let me nose it up.

lines.zh: 这捆麦子我咬着，别抢。
lines.en: I've got this bundle in my teeth; don't grab it.

lines.zh: 地上那块皮，是我的味道。
lines.en: That hide on the ground smells like me.

lines.zh: 我低头把它拱到你脚边。
lines.en: I lower my head and nudge it to your feet.

lines.zh: 嘴里有东西，我就叫不出来了。
lines.en: With something in my mouth I can't low properly.

lines.zh: 这块石头我叼不动。
lines.en: This stone is too much for my teeth.

lines.zh: 你掉的鞍，我拖着走了一段。
lines.en: I dragged your dropped saddle a little way.

lines.zh: 别塞太多，我嘴就这么大。
lines.en: Don't load me up; my mouth is only so big.

lines.zh: 我把它放在槽边，算收好了。
lines.en: I set it by the trough, which counts as put away.

lines.zh: 那头狼在绕圈，我盯住它了。
lines.en: That wolf is circling; I've got my eye on it.

lines.zh: 它靠近小牛，我就转过去。
lines.en: It's nearing the calf, so I turn toward it.

lines.zh: 我选最前面那头，它最慌。
lines.en: I pick the one in front; it's the most panicked.

lines.zh: 角朝下，我慢慢对准方向。
lines.en: Horns down, I slowly line myself up.

lines.zh: 有人踢了牛群，我记住了。
lines.en: Someone kicked the herd; I remember.

lines.zh: 我的目标只是把它赶出去。
lines.en: My only aim is to drive it off.

lines.zh: 灰白的牛也能护住自己人。
lines.en: Even a pale cow can guard its own.

lines.zh: 我盯上那团影子，它动了。
lines.en: I fix on that shadow; it just moved.

lines.zh: 先站稳，再想怎么冲。
lines.en: First plant my feet, then think about charging.

lines.zh: 牛群在后面，我不能退。
lines.en: The herd is behind me; I can't back off.

lines.zh: 我一步一步跟着它，不急。
lines.en: I follow it step by step, unhurried.

lines.zh: 它箭头一偏，我的角跟着偏。
lines.en: It veers; my horns veer with it.

lines.zh: 蹄子压低，草被踩得没声。
lines.en: I lower my hooves so the grass won't give me away.

lines.zh: 我们隔着三步，谁都没动。
lines.en: Three paces between us and neither one moves.

lines.zh: 我记得它刚才咬过谁。
lines.en: I remember who it bit a moment ago.

lines.zh: 呼吸放到最慢，让它以为我走了。
lines.en: I slow my breath so it thinks I've gone.

lines.zh: 它退到栅栏边，没路了。
lines.en: It backs to the fence; there's no way left.

lines.zh: 角尖对着它，我不用跑。
lines.en: Horns pointed at it, I don't need to run.

lines.zh: 牛群安静下来，都在看我。
lines.en: The herd goes quiet and watches me.

lines.zh: 再近一步，我就该动了。
lines.en: One more step and I'll have to move.

lines.zh: 我低头一顶，把它撞开。
lines.en: I drop my head and butt it away.

lines.zh: 牛角撞上去，它退了三步。
lines.en: My horns land and it retreats three steps.

lines.zh: 角刮过它的侧腹。
lines.en: My horn scrapes along its flank.

lines.zh: 我前蹄刨地，然后冲。
lines.en: I paw the ground, then charge.

lines.zh: 顶完这一下，我前蹄发麻。
lines.en: After that butt, my front hooves tingle.

lines.zh: 别逼我，我只会这一招。
lines.en: Don't push me; this is the only move I have.

lines.zh: 它被顶得滚了半圈。
lines.en: It rolls half a turn from the blow.

lines.zh: 我的角不尖，疼的是分量。
lines.en: My horns aren't sharp; the weight is what hurts.

lines.zh: 鼻子里那股血味，让我想跑。
lines.en: That blood smell in my nose makes me want to run.

lines.zh: 顶开就够了，我不追。
lines.en: Driving it off is enough; I don't chase.

lines.zh: 我睁开眼，脚下是平原的草。
lines.en: I open my eyes to plains grass underfoot.

lines.zh: 身边已经站着几头棕色的牛。
lines.en: A few brown cows already stand beside me.

lines.zh: 灰白的毛还没干，风一吹就凉。
lines.en: My pale coat is still damp and the wind is cold.

lines.zh: 我不知道自己从哪儿来。
lines.en: Where I came from, I have no idea.

lines.zh: 第一件事是找草吃。
lines.en: The first thing is to find grass.

lines.zh: 平原的太阳照着我的灰背。
lines.en: The plains sun beats down on my grey back.

lines.zh: 牛群里有人给我让了个位置。
lines.en: Someone in the herd makes room for me.

lines.zh: 我试着叫了一声，声音有点哑。
lines.en: I try a low and my voice comes out hoarse.

lines.zh: 泥地上留着我来时的蹄印。
lines.en: Hoofprints in the mud show where I arrived.

lines.zh: 站起来的腿还有点软。
lines.en: My legs are still soft as I get up.

lines.zh: 皮毛烧焦的味道，很冲。
lines.en: The smell of singed hide is sharp.

lines.zh: 从坡上滚下来，骨头嗡了一声。
lines.en: I rolled down the slope and my bones rang.

lines.zh: 河水灌进来，牛嘴合不上了。
lines.en: River water pours in and my jaw won't close.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我这头灰牛掀了个跟头。
lines.en: The blast flips this grey cow head over heels.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进肩里，还在抖。
lines.en: Something sticks in my shoulder, still quivering.

lines.zh: 奇怪的光爬上我的腿。
lines.en: Strange light crawls up my legs.

lines.zh: 饿得反刍都停了，胃里空响。
lines.en: Too hungry to chew cud; my stomach echoes.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来的味道像铁。
lines.en: The lightning leaves a taste like iron.

lines.zh: 下面是空的，我一直在掉。
lines.en: There's nothing beneath me and I keep falling.
